3403-the-register.title: The Register
3403-the-register.creator: Unknown
3403-the-register.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Miss Reed_: “That’s because you keep fussing about so. Why don’t you be quiet, if you want to hear?”  She lifts her voice to its highest pitch, with a pause for distinctness between the words: “I’m heart-broken for—Ponkwasset. The dryads—of the—birch woods. The nymphs—and the great—god—Pan—in the reeds—by the river. And all—that—sort of—thing!”

37625-our-old-home-vol-2-annotated-with-.title: Our Old Home Vol 2 Annotated With Passages From The Author S
37625-our-old-home-vol-2-annotated-with-.creator: Unknown
37625-our-old-home-vol-2-annotated-with-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It was a sunny and beautiful day, a specimen of the perfect English weather, just warm enough for comfort,--indeed, a little too warm, perhaps, in the noontide sun,--yet retaining a mere spice or suspicion of austerity, which made it all the more enjoyable.

arxiv-1909-01497.title: Iterative Clustering with Game-Theoretic Matching for Robust Multi-consistency Correspondence
arxiv-1909-01497.creator: Chen Zhao, Jiaqi Yang, Ke Xian, Zhiguo Cao, Xin Li
arxiv-1909-01497.description: Abstract Matching corresponding features between two images is a fundamental task to computer vision with numerous applications in object recognition, robotics, and 3D reconstruction. Current state of the art in image feature matching has focused on establishing a single consistency in static scenes; by contrast, finding multiple consistencies in dynamic scenes has been under-researched.

arxiv-1912-03464.title: Generalized Extended Riemann-Liouville type fractional derivative operator
arxiv-1912-03464.description: Abstract In this paper, we aim to present new extensions of incomplete gamma, beta, Gauss hypergeometric, confluent hypergeometric function and Appell-Lauricella hypergeometric functions, by using the extended Bessel function due to Boudjelkha [ 4 ] . Some recurrence relations, transformation formulas, Mellin transform and integral representations are obtained for these generalizations.

arxiv-2010-15076.title: Vacuum expectation value renormalization in the Standard Model and beyond Preprint: KA-TP-18-2020, P3H-20-063
arxiv-2010-15076.creator: Vytautas Dūdėnas, Maximilian Löschner
arxiv-2010-15076.description: Abstract We show how the renormalization constant of the Higgs vacuum expectation value, fixed by a tadpole condition, is responsible for gauge dependencies in various definitions of parameters in the R ξ R_{\xi} -gauge. Then we show the relationship of this renormalization constant to the Fleischer-Jegerlehner (FJ) scheme, which is used to avoid these gauge dependencies.

arxiv-2105-09791.title: Will Betelguese Explode?
arxiv-2105-09791.creator: Priya Hasan
arxiv-2105-09791.description: Abstract Since October 2019, Betelgeuse began to dim noticeably and by January 2020 its brightness had dropped by a factor of approximately 2.5, demoting it from the position of the top (apparent) brightest 11 th star to the 21 st!!! Astronomers were excited and thought of it as the lull before the storm, Betelguese was ready to go supernova!!!

arxiv-2204-07548.title: Learning Multi-View Aggregation In the Wild for Large-Scale 3D Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2204-07548.creator: Damien Robert damien.robert@ign.fr, Bruno Vallet bruno.vallet@ign.fr, Loic Landrieu loic.landrieu@ign.fr
arxiv-2204-07548.description: Abstract Recent works on 3D semantic segmentation propose to exploit the synergy between images and point clouds by processing each modality with a dedicated network and projecting learned 2D features onto 3D points. Merging large-scale point clouds and images raises several challenges, such as constructing a mapping between points and pixels, and aggregating features between multiple views.

arxiv-2303-12618.title: A Perceptual Quality Assessment Exploration for AIGC Images
arxiv-2303-12618.creator: Zicheng Zhang*, Chunyi Li*, Wei Sun, Xiaohong Liu, Xiongkuo Min, and Guangtao Zhai
arxiv-2303-12618.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zicheng Zhang*, Chunyi Li*, Wei Sun, Xiaohong Liu, Xiongkuo Min, and Guangtao Zhai. AI G enerated C ontent ( AIGC ) has gained widespread attention with the increasing efficiency of deep learning in content creation. AIGC, created with the assistance of artificial intelligence technology, includes various forms of content, among which the AI-generated images (AGIs) have brought significant impact to society and have been applied to various fields such as entertainment, education, social media, etc.

arxiv-2306-09611.title: Multi-MeV electrons from above-threshold ionization of the neon K-shell
arxiv-2306-09611.creator: A. Yandow, T. N. Ha, C. Aniculaesei, H. L. Smith, C. G. Richmond, M. M. Spinks, H. J. Quevedo, S. Bruce, M. Darilek, C. Chang, D. A. Garcia, E. Gaul, M. E. Donovan, B. M. Hegelich, T. Ditmire
arxiv-2306-09611.description: Abstract We present measurements of integrated electron energies produced by above-threshold ionization (ATI) of neon in a laser field with intensity exceeding 10 20 10^{20} W/cm 2 . We observe electrons with energy exceeding 10 MeV ejected in the laser forward direction above a threshold intensity of 2 × 10 20 \times 10^{20} W/cm 2 .

arxiv-2412-11474.title: Noise-Resilient Homomorphic Encryption: A Framework for Secure Data Processing in Health care Domain
arxiv-2412-11474.creator: B. Shuriya Department of Computer Science and Engineering PPG Institute of Technology Coimbatore 641035, India shuriyasmile@gmail.com, S. Vimal Kumar Department of Defense System Engineering Sejong University Seoul 05006, Republic of Korea svimalkumar16@gmail.com, K. Bagyalakshmi Department of Mathe
arxiv-2412-11474.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce the Fully Homomorphic Integrity Model (HIM), a novel approach designed to enhance security, efficiency, and reliability in encrypted data processing, primarily within the health care industry. HIM addresses the key challenges that noise accumulation, computational overheads, and data integrity pose during homomorphic operations.

arxiv-2501-14296.title: Multi-stage Large Language Model Pipelines Can Outperform GPT-4o in Relevance Assessment Conference: Proceedings of The Web Conference; April 28 – May 2, 2025; Sydney, Australia Proceedings of The Web Conference (WebConf ’25), April 28 – May 2, 2025, Sydney, Australia DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference
arxiv-2501-14296.creator: Julian A. Schnabel, Johanne R. Trippas, Falk Scholer, Danula Hettiachchi
arxiv-2501-14296.description: Abstract . The effectiveness of search systems is evaluated using relevance labels that indicate the usefulness of documents for specific queries and users. While obtaining these relevance labels from real users is ideal, scaling such data collection is challenging. Consequently, third-party annotators are employed, but their inconsistent accuracy demands costly auditing, training, and monitoring.

arxiv-2503-15345.title: Is the Radcliffe wave turbulent?
arxiv-2503-15345.creator: Itzhak Goldman
arxiv-2503-15345.description: Abstract Context. Tidal interaction with a satellite galaxy and Kelvin Helmholtz instability were proposed as the generation mechanisms of the Radcliffe wave. In each of these scenarios it is likely that turbulence could be generated. Aims. We intend to find out wether the wave is turbulent, and if so to obtain the turbulence characteristics. Methods.

arxiv-2508-07194.title: ProtoScan Measuring censorship in IPv6
arxiv-2508-07194.creator: Jack Wampler, Hammas Bin Tanveer, Rishab Nithyanand, Eric Wustrow
arxiv-2508-07194.description: Abstract Internet censorship continues to impact billions of people worldwide, and measurement of it remains an important focus of research. However, most Internet censorship measurements have focused solely on the IPv4 Internet infrastructure. Yet, more clients and servers are available over IPv6: According to Google, over a third of their users now have native IPv6 access.

arxiv-2508-18334.title: Closed Formulas for η \eta -Corrections in the Once Punctured Torus
arxiv-2508-18334.creator: Nelson Abdiel Colón Vargas
arxiv-2508-18334.description: Abstract We study η \eta -correction terms in the Kauffman bracket skein algebra of the once-punctured torus K t ​ ( Σ 1 , 1 ) K_{t}(\Sigma_{1,1}) . While the Frohman-Gelca product-to-sum rule is explicit on the closed torus, punctures introduce correction terms in the ideal ( η ) (\eta) whose structure has resisted systematic description beyond low-determinant cases.

arxiv-2510-23054.title: Supersymmetric higher-derivative models in quantum cosmology
arxiv-2510-23054.creator: Nephtalí Eliceo Martínez Pérez, Cupatitzio Ramírez Romero
arxiv-2510-23054.description: Abstract We study the quantum cosmology of supersymmetric, homogeneous and isotropic, higher derivative models. We recall superfield actions obtained in previous works and give classically equivalent actions leading to second order equations for the bosons, and first order for the fermions.

pmc-11437089.title: A patient report scale research to access the symptom burden in patients with IgA nephropathy
pmc-11437089.creator: Nan Yang, Jiyu Tang, Xiaodi Li, Dingcheng Li, Bin Zhu, Qiang He, Yuqun Zeng, Juan Jin
pmc-11437089.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Patients diagnosed with IgA nephropathy (IgAN) commonly experience a substantial burden of symptoms encompassing both physical and psychological aspects. Presently, there's a dearth of standardized assessment tools to effectively gauge the extent of symptom burden in IgAN patients. Therefore, this study aims to devise an IgAN Symptom Assessment Tool that enables a comprehensive evaluation of patient symptom burden and their self-perceived severity. Employing a prospective observational design, this study conducted a survey among patients diagnosed with IgAN at a hospital in China.

pmc-11862843.title: Impact of reconstruction techniques on low dose chest CT image quality: comparison of FBP, Clear View at Mzuzu Central Hospital, Malawi
pmc-11862843.creator: Hui Zhang, Blessed Kondowe, Jiaojiao Zhang, Xinming Xie, Qiang Song, Gang Niu, Jin Shang
pmc-11862843.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectiveTo investigate the impact of two reconstruction techniques, Filtered Back Projection (FBP) and Clear View (CV) iterative algorithm, on the image quality of low-dose thin-slice chest CT.MethodsA retrospective study of 42 patients undergoing low-dose chest CT at Mzuzu Central Hospital from Feb-Apr 2024 used automatic tube current modulation at 120 kV Raw data were reconstructed with FBP, 20% CV, 40% CV, 60% CV, and 80% CV, with 1 mm slice thickness and 0.625 mm spacing.

pmc-12668875.title: Interleukin-2 Surface Displayed M1 Macrophage-Derived Extracellular Vesicles for Modulating the Tumor Microenvironment
pmc-12668875.creator: Kyeong Tae Kim, Jeong Hyun Lee, Su Jin Kang, Won Jong Rhee
pmc-12668875.description: PurposeCancer immunotherapy aims to enhance the immune system’s ability to recognize and eliminate cancer cells, providing a sustained and effective immune response. However, the tumor microenvironment (TME), characterized by an abundance of tumor-associated M2 macrophages and the presence of exhausted or naïve T cells (non-effector T cells), remains a major barrier to effective immunotherapy.

pmc-12718985.title: Exploring the diagnostic and prognostic significance of circulating tumor cells in stage II-IV colorectal cancer using a nano-based detection method
pmc-12718985.creator: Gang Liu, Jinfeng Zhu, Pengbo Zhang, Tingting Zhang, Zheng Cui, Fanglei Jiao, Wenjun Le, Xiaofeng Li, Bingdi Chen
pmc-12718985.description: Background:Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a leading cause of cancer mortality globally, underscoring the urgency for a noninvasive and effective biomarker to enhance patient prognosis. Circulating tumor cells (CTCs), a potential marker for real-time tumor monitoring, are limited in clinical utility due to the low sensitivity of existing detection methods.

pmc-13015216.title: Exercise-induced fatigue affects lower limb biomechanics in high-risk backhand smash landings among female badminton players
pmc-13015216.creator: Binyong Ye, Bin Zhang, Zhanyang He, Chuimei Sheng, Gongju Liu, Houwei Zhu, Guanliang Meng
pmc-13015216.description: SummaryThis study used one-dimensional statistical parametric mapping (SPM1d) to examine how exercise-induced fatigue affects lower limb biomechanics during landing from high-risk backhand smashes, including the backhand rear-court jump smash (BRJS) and backhand lateral jump smash (BLJS), in elite female badminton players.

pmc-13106130.title: Association between gut microbiota composition and ischemic colitis: a comparative analysis
pmc-13106130.creator: Rui Feng, Qi Tang, Liang Xu, Yue Yao, Hai-Yan Shen, Xin-Feng Shen, Shui-Liang Ruan
pmc-13106130.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to examine the association between gut microbiota composition and ischemic colitis (IC) by comparing the microbial diversity and abundance in individuals diagnosed with IC and healthy controls.MethodsA comparative analysis of gut microbiota was conducted in 18 individuals with IC and 11 healthy controls. Microbial community structure was assessed at both the phylum and genus levels.

pmc-13377316.title: The Effectiveness of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy Group Intervention (Navigator ACT) for Parents of Children With Neurodevelopmental Disabilities: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13377316.creator: T Holmberg Bergman, P Lappalainen, A Ghaderi, T Hirvikoski
pmc-13377316.description: High levels of parental stress and psychological inflexibility are common among caregivers raising children with neurodevelopmental disabilities. Navigator ACT is a group‐based treatment developed to increase psychological flexibility and reduce the impact of stress among parents of children with various disabilities (e.g., autism spectrum disorder, ADHD, intellectual disability, acquired brain injury).

pmc-13438293.title: From support and interaction to continuance: affective pathways and the bright side of cognitive load in English-medium instruction
pmc-13438293.creator: Wenyan Yi
pmc-13438293.description: English-medium instruction (EMI) is increasingly adopted in higher education, yet learners differ in their willingness to persist in EMI courses. While prior research has highlighted the cognitive and emotional demands of EMI learning, the relationships among these demands, learners’ affective evaluations, and their continuance intention remain insufficiently examined.
